title: 戦略会計入門
subtitle: Management Accounting Basic
keywords: CVP analysis and profit chart 2.Profit plan master plan 3.Estimated balance sheet 4.Working capital 5.Cash flow management
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the “Financial Accounting Basic Ability” learning/education goal of the Department of Management Information. It aims to cultivate in the students various skills related to the creation of profit plans and cash plans, using exercises relating accounting information and the financial management of companies from a profit management and money management perspective.
advice: This course consists of three parts: In the first part, students will learn about variable income statements, CVP analysis, and profit charts. In the second part, students will learn to create profit plans, focusing on relevant exercises. In the third part, we will cover topics from profit planning to financial planning, focusing on exercises. Since there are numbers of exercises to prepare, it is important that students take an active approach to the class.
requiredKnowledge: Students should review the contents of Basic Accounting, a course that must be taken prior to this course. It is also important for students to understand that the contents learned in this course will be needed for "Strategic Accounting Application".

activityGoals.body: Be able to create a variable income statement and perform a CVP analysis.
Be able to create a profit plan master plan following the profit plan creation procedure.
Be able to create an estimated income statement.
Be able to understand the importance of cash flow management.
Be able to create an estimated balance sheet / estimated cash flow statement.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・Understand the significance of CVP analysis and how to use profit charts and conduct simulations using CVP sensitivity analysis. ・Be able to systematically calculate required profit and prepare a budget using the proper procedure. ・Be able to create an estimated balance sheet / estimated cash flow statement using the proper procedure for creating a financial plan. ・Understand the importance of cash flow management. ・Understand how to obtain working capital and understand the importance of cash flow.
achievementLevels.standard: ・Understand the significance of CVP analysis and how to use profit charts and conduct simulations through CVP sensitivity analysis. ・Be able to systematically calculate required profit and prepare a budget using the proper procedure. ・Be able to create an estimated balance sheet / estimated cash flow statement using the proper procedure for creating a financial plan.

Significance and purpose of financial management Variable income statement
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Organize class notes to deepen understanding of the significance and purpose of financial management. A variable income statement can be prepared.

lessons.content: CVP analysis (1) 1. Variable and fixed costs 2. Break-even point 3. Profit chart
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Understand variable and fixed costs and profit charts while completing assignments.

lessons.content: CVP analysis (2) 1. Significance of CVP analysis 2. Review of profit chart
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Understand the significance of CVP analysis and create profit charts while completing assigned tasks.

lessons.content: CVP analysis (3) 1. Utilization of profit chart 2. Significance and utilization of contribution margin
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Make use of profit charts while doing assignments. In addition, make sure that the meaning of contribution margin is understood and utilized.

lessons.content: [General exercises] Comprehensive exercises on class content from classes 1 to 4
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Make use of profit charts while doing the assignments. In addition, make sure that the meaning of contribution margin is understood and utilized.

lessons.content: [Interim test] Exam on class contents from classes 1 to 5
lessons.operation: Lecture and Q & A Exercises Written exam
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Deepen understanding of the contents of classes 1 to 5 while completing assignments.

lessons.content: Profit plan (1) 1. Calculation of required sales 2. Calculation of break-even point in various cases
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Make use of profit charts while doing the assignments. In addition, make sure that the meaning of contribution margin is understood and utilized.

lessons.content: Profit plan (2) 1. Calculation of required profit 2. Profit plan master plan creation
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Undertake tasks to gain a deeper understanding of the required profit calculation process and profit planning master plan creation process.

lessons.content: Profit plan (3) 1. Preparation of estimated income statement 2. Creation of itemized budget
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Deepen understanding of the creation of estimated profit and loss statements and budget statements while completing assignments.

lessons.content: Cash flow management 1. Principles of cash flow management 2. Understanding cash flow
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Deepen understanding of the importance of cash flow management while completing assigned tasks.

lessons.content: Creation of a financial plan (1) 1. Meaning of working capital and calculation method 2. Procedure for creating a financial plan
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Deepen understanding of the meaning and calculation method of working capital while completing assigned tasks.

lessons.content: Creation of a financial plan (2) Create an estimated balance sheet
lessons.assignments: Preparation: Read the relevant part of the text and organize the questions. Review: Deepen understanding of how to create an estimated balance sheet while completing assignments.
